description: Tao (2019) proved almost all Collatz orbits attain almost bounded values in logarithmic density. His proof uses renewal processes on 3-adic cyclic groups. This concept extends his framework to predict delay record density.
mathematical_formalization: For any f: N+1 -> R with lim f(N) = infinity, Col_min(N) <= f(N) for almost all N (logarithmic density). Delay records correspond to the extreme tail of this distribution.
analogical_connections: Extreme value theory: delay records follow GEV distribution
implementation_hypothesis: Fit extreme value distribution to 147 known delay records. Predict position of 148th record.
experiment_seed: Plot delay record index vs log(record_number). Test linearity. Compute 95% CI for next record.
